description: Raised middle with a wall + twin stairs on the AFT face (W1x standard, closes to a low aft neighbour) and a connected FORWARD face (W1xR standard). Same W1x lower hull below Z 1.76 as hull.middle.w1x.v1. Visuals: hull.middle.w1xr.v1's Midship_W1 shell (re-closed at the aft interface) plus Astra's raised-stern wall/stair kit (art-staging/modular-width-raised-v1) mirrored about X=9.30 onto the aft face. See docs/RAISED-SECTIONS.md sec 3-4.
boundsNote: X/Y/Z unchanged from hull.middle.w1xr.v1 -- the wall is an interior closure, not a hull silhouette change.

sockets.notes: Wall face: W1x standard per RAISED-SECTIONS.md sec 2 (a wall/no-wall pairing, never two raised faces meeting without a wall).
Kept from hull.middle.w1xr.v1; clearance box measured clear of the aft stairwell (stairwell local x 0-3.24, box x 2.6-4.4 -> just clears). Assembler check pending.

visuals.notes: Re-closed at the aft face (X=0 local) with a flat bulkhead cap between the two stair-corner Y bands, Z 1.70-4.20; open at the forward face (connected). 0 boundary anomalies, 0 degenerate faces (tools/blender/verify_modular_raised_sections_v1.py).

Astra's raised-stern Door, mirrored about X=9.30 (world) onto the aft face. Cosmetic placement over the closed bulkhead; not boolean-cut as a walkable hole -- see docs/RAISED-SECTIONS.md Data+art results for the caveat.
Astra's TwinStairs, mirrored; run occupies local x 0-3.24, i.e. the aft 54% of this 6 u bay.
